reason: The guarantee is to stipulate that the Lessor's rights are 'extinguished' unless a claim is lodged within 90 days of the event. Even as a term of the bank's guarantee, Exception 3 needs a period of at least one year; 90 days is less. Extinguishment on the expiry of a period. Void.
The Lessor will not let space in the Building to a Competitor (cl. 1A) during the Term. A restriction on how the Lessor deals with its own property, in-term only.
The Lessor's apportionment is final among occupants, but the Lessee may expressly take a dispute about its share to arbitration under cl. 16. The forum is preserved (as PO-42).

The Existing Difference (cl. 1B) arose before the deed, and it goes to arbitration by a mutually appointed arbitrator, with no other forum. A written agreement to arbitrate a question that has already arisen. Saved by Exception 2 (and Exception 1).
Mutual termination on 3 months' notice. A step under the contract, with nothing about claims, courts or trade.
Notice of breach and 30 days to remedy. A cure step; nothing about claims or courts.

For 2 years after the deed ends, no software consulting within the same industrial estate, backed by agreed damages and an injunction. A post-lease restraint with no goodwill sold. Void, and so are the damages and injunction attached to it.

The Exclusivity Period (cl. 1.1A) is the term only, so this is in-term, but it bars the business from any other premises within 3 km. That is business elsewhere, and the landlord's interest is not apparent from the deed (as PO-11, PO-39). Refer.
Limits a suit for refund of excess maintenance charges to 180 days from the end of the financial year, against 3 years under the Limitation Act. Shortens the time to sue. Void.

A claim not raised within the Settlement Period (45 days after the Lessor's final statement, cl. 1B) is 'deemed to have been waived', and the Lessor 'shall stand discharged'. Waiver and discharge on the expiry of a period. Void.
Courts at Thane 'alone'. The premises are at Mouje Elthan, Taluka and District Thane, so those courts have jurisdiction over the property anyway. Subject to the cl. 18 arbitration. Valid.
A bill not objected to within a week 'is treated as agreed and can no longer be challenged'. A deemed-acceptance clause that takes away the right on the expiry of a period. Void.

The Building Engineer is the Lessor's own employee (cl. 1.1A), and his determination 'shall not be referred to arbitration or to any court'. Not an independent expert, and every forum is expressly shut out, overriding cl. 6.8 for that class of disputes. Void.

Unless arbitration starts within 90 days of vacating, the Lessee 'shall have no right to such refund'. The right is extinguished on the expiry of a period, against 3 years (Arts. 55/113, via s.43 of the 1996 Act). Void.

The Lessor's own sub-meter and bills are final and 'shall not be disputed ... before any court or arbitrator'. One party's figures, with every forum excluded, overriding cl. 12(E). Void to that extent.

The Final Bill is the Lessor's own bill (cl. 1A). It is made final, and the Lessee waives every right to dispute it 'before any court, arbitrator or authority'. One party decides and every forum is shut out. Void to that extent.
Mesne profits for holding over at a fixed Rs. 10,000 a day. Whether that is a penalty is a s.74 question.

Security-service claims are to be settled 'by mutual discussion only', and may not go to arbitration or to any court. Discussion is not a forum, so nothing is left for that class of claims; it overrides cl. 18(b). Void to that extent.
One year after the lease ends, no business of the same nature within the local authority's area. A post-lease restraint with no goodwill sold. Void.
Forfeiture of the whole security deposit for any breach. Whether that is a penalty is a s.74 question, not ss.27-28.
Suspension of air-conditioning and lifts while dues are outstanding. A self-help remedy, not a limit on going to court (as PO-44).

The guarantee extinguishes the Lessors' rights, and discharges the bank, unless a claim is made within 3 months of its expiry. Exception 3 needs a period of at least one year, so it does not apply. Extinguishment on the expiry of a period. Void.
For 2 years after surrender, the Lessee may not occupy premises within 4 km for software development. A post-lease restraint with no goodwill sold. Void.
The Lessors are not answerable for loss from theft, burglary or fire. An exclusion of liability: it limits what is recoverable, not access to court.
User clause: an office for chemical storage and distribution only, and not residential. Restricts use of the Property only.

Goodwill is transferred and the area is specified (Siruseri), but the restraint runs a fixed 7 years 'whether or not' the buyer carries on the business. Exception 1 requires it to last only so long as the buyer carries on a like business. Void.
For parking claims the Lessee has 'no recourse to any court, arbitrator or other forum'. An absolute bar for that class of claims, overriding cl. 26. Void to that extent.

The handover and make-good terms are unobjectionable. But for 18 months after handover the Lessee may not compete with other occupants' businesses in the locality. A post-lease restraint with no goodwill sold. Void to that extent.
Bills are payable in 15 days, but expressly without prejudice to the right to dispute them later and recover any overcharge. No right is lost.
Deposit-refund disputes go to binding arbitration ('shall be finally resolved') at Chennai under the 1996 Act, and suits are excluded except for s.9 interim relief. Saved by Exception 1.
A binding arbitration agreement ('shall be referred') with a sole arbitrator by mutual consent under the 1996 Act, seated in Gurgaon. Saved by Exception 1.
Two years after the deed ends, within 3 km, including through affiliates. A post-lease restraint with no goodwill sold. Void.

Arbitration only 'may' happen 'by mutual consent', which is not an arbitration agreement (Jagdish Chander), and failing that the Lessors' own decision is final and 'no court shall entertain any claim'. The deed has no other arbitration clause, so no forum is left. Void.

Bangalore courts exclusively, 'to the exclusion of all other courts'. But the premises are at Madhapur, Hyderabad, both parties have their registered offices there, and the deed was executed there. Nothing connects Bangalore, and parties cannot confer jurisdiction (A.B.C. Laminart), so this ousts the competent courts. Void. It also conflicts with Article XXIII (Hyderabad).
Three years from when the arrears became payable, the same as Art. 52. Not shorter, so not void (as PO-37).
In-term only, but it bars a second software office anywhere in Siruseri. That is business elsewhere, not use of the plot, and the landlord's interest is not apparent from the deed (as PO-11). Refer.

Post-lease restraint: 12 months after vacating, 2 km of the Building. No goodwill sold. The recital that the rent reflects the Lessor's interest does not bring it within Exception 1. Void however limited.
A notice step (change of name or office within 30 days). No consequence for claims or courts.
Twelve years from determination of the lease for the Lessor's possession suit, the same as Art. 67. Not shorter, so not void.
The Lessor will not let other parts of the building to a similar business during the demise. A restriction on how the Lessor deals with its own property, in-term only.
User clause: office use only, and no noisy, offensive or dangerous trade on the premises. Restricts use of these premises only.
Damages are the Lessee's sole remedy; no specific performance or injunction. The court stays open for damages, so this is a remedies question, not s.28 (as PO-29).
A suit for the deposit or other sums must be brought within the Limitation Window (120 days after the deed ends, cl. 1A), against 3 years under Arts. 55/113. Shortens the time to sue. Void.

The Lessor sold the Canteen Goodwill (cl. 1B) to the Lessee and restrains itself within the estate (a specified local limit) for as long as the buyer, or someone deriving title from it, carries on a canteen business there. All three conditions of Exception 1 are met, and whether the limits are reasonable is for the court. Refer.

The Lessors may not file 'any suit, arbitration or other proceeding' for rent arrears; adjustment against the deposit is their only remedy. An absolute restriction on enforcing that right, even where the arrears exceed the deposit (as PO-57). Section 28 protects the landlord too. Void to that extent.
